description: A shell script using test-lib.sh to test git remote group handling functionalities, including updating repositories, checking remote logs, and handling remote groups in various scenarios.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Writes the provided string into a file named 'mark' to signal a specific state or event during tests.

methods.name: update_repo
methods.description: Updates a git repository by adding a file and committing with a message read from 'mark'.

methods.name: update_repos
methods.description: Updates multiple repositories by calling update_repo on each.

methods.name: repo_fetched
methods.description: Checks if the latest commit message in a repository matches the message in 'mark', indicating the repo was fetched.
